description: Olufalansa lwogerwa ku ssemazinga zonna ttaano, okuva e Paris ne Montreal okutuuka e Kinshasa, Dakar ne Abidjan, era abasinga okulwogera bali mu Afrika.
notes: Drafted by Claude (AI) for the French courses (#145); needs a native-speaker review. The Luganda needs a native-speaker review; word and unit notes fall back to the English notes (lang/en/about/fr).

why.title: Olulimi lw’**ekitundu kya Afrika, n’okusingawo.**
why.text: Olufalansa lulimi lwa ggwanga mu nsi za Afrika ezisukka mu abiri, okuva e Senegal okutuuka e Congo, ne mu baliraanwa ba Uganda, Rwanda ne Burundi. Luyige otambule, osome, okole emirimu okusukka ensalo era onyumirwe ennyimba, okuva ku rumba okutuuka ku coupé-décalé.

cards.title: Eri abatambuze
cards.text: Tambula okuva e Kigali okutuuka e Kinshasa, Dakar oba Paris.

cards.title: Ku mulimu
cards.text: Suubula, soma era okole n’abantu mu Afrika yonna eyoogera Olufalansa.

cards.title: Eri abaagala okumanya
cards.text: Zuula amannya ag’ekikazi n’ekisajja, ennukuta ezitasomebwa n’ennamba ezeewuunyisa.

landing.audience: Aboogera Oluganda abatandika okuva ku ntandikwa: abayizi, abatambuze n’abasuubuzi abagenda mu nsi ezoogera Olufalansa.
landing.first: Okulamusa, okwennyanjula n’ennamba, oluvannyuma ab’omu maka, emmere, akatale, essaawa, ebifo, awaka n’obulamu, ekitundu ku kitundu.
